Do you use competitors' brand names as keywords?
No. Using another brand's name in your listing breaks Amazon's rules. We use generic and descriptive phrases that shoppers search for, and drop any terms that Amazon says are not allowed.
Will edits cause my listing to be suppressed?
We check changes against Amazon's style guide before saving, and keep a copy of every old version. If a listing is flagged, we restore or correct it straight away.
Can you change the product images?
We review them and plan the slots. Making new images is a separate service, listing images, which you can add. We never upload images that show claims you cannot support.
desc:
Amazon listing optimization and keywords make your existing product pages easier to find and easier to understand. Ecom Swift LLC reviews your titles, bullets, backend keywords, descriptions and images, rewrites what needs it and records old and new text for comparison.

## What is Amazon listing optimization?

Listing optimization is the work of improving a live product page so it matches what shoppers search for and answers what they want to know. It covers the visible text, the hidden backend search terms, the data fields and the image set. The aim is clarity and relevance, not tricks.

Most listings are written once, at launch, and never touched again. Search habits change, competitors add better pages, and your own range grows. A page that was fine a year ago can now be missing the words shoppers use today.

## Why a tired listing costs you orders

When a product page does not use the shopper's words, Amazon has less reason to show it for that search. When it is shown, a vague title or a wall of text in the bullets gives the shopper little reason to click. Both problems lower the share of searchers who reach your page and the share of visitors who buy.

There are quiet costs as well. Missing attributes keep a product out of filtered results. A main image that does not fill the frame looks small beside others. Each fix is minor alone, and together they decide how a page performs.

## How better copy and structure help results

Amazon reads titles, bullets, attributes and backend fields to match products to searches. Putting the main phrase near the start of the title, using each bullet for one clear benefit, and keeping backend terms free of repeats helps the system understand the product. Shoppers then read the same text to decide, so clear writing serves both audiences.

Results depend on price, reviews, stock and competition, so we cannot promise a ranking or a sales increase. What we can control is how well the page explains the product and how closely it follows Amazon's rules.

## What a thorough optimization covers

- Keyword research for each listing, using the phrases shoppers search for.
- A rewritten title that fits Amazon's style limit and reads naturally.
- Five bullets with one benefit each, in an order that answers questions.
- A description whose first screen holds the main message.
- Backend search terms refreshed without repeating visible words.
- Category and attribute fields checked for gaps.
- An image set review with a plan for each image slot.
- A record of old and new text so changes can be compared.
- A catalog keyword map for larger packages.

## How we work on your listings

We begin by reading each listing as a shopper would, then as the search system would. We note what is missing, repeated or unclear. For each product we research keywords and choose the phrases that fit the item honestly.

We then rewrite the fields that need it in your Seller Central account, keeping the old text on file. Edits are made with care, because some changes can trigger a review of the page. The Basic, Standard and Premium packages cover more listings, add keyword research and description rewrites, and at the top level include a catalog keyword map, a test plan for titles and images, and a before and after report.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Lead with the words shoppers actually type.
- Change one major element at a time so you can see its effect.
- Keep every claim accurate and supportable.
- Update listings when the product changes.
- Keep a copy of the old text before editing.

**Avoid:**
- Using other brands' names as search terms.
- Repeating the same keyword many times in the title.
- Adding promotional phrases such as sale or free shipping.
- Editing a best-selling page in several ways at once.
- Copying competitor wording word for word.

## Who this is for

This service suits a seller whose listings have been live for a long time and are no longer pulling their weight. It also suits an owner who inherited a catalog with inconsistent text and wants a tidy, uniform voice. A brand preparing for a busy season can use it to review its main products first.

## What we need from you

Please send a list of the listings to improve, your top products, any keywords you know matter and notes on your best-known features. You invite us as a user in your Seller Central account with listing permissions. We never need your password, and we keep a record of each change we make.
